services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: At Skydive the Ranch, innovation and safety go hand in hand. As an early adopter of cutting-edge training tools, we’re proud to offer our students a unique way to build their skills and confidence before ever stepping on board a plane. Enter the virtual reality parachute flight simulator-a groundbreaking tool designed to revolutionize the way skydiving students prepare to learn to fly their parachutes before their first jump. Skydiving is an exhilarating sport, but it comes with challenges that demand precise training and sound decision-making. That’s where virtual reality shines. blurb: Guests can experience a tandem skydive from 13,500 feet with a freefall to 6,000 feet before parachute deployment. The center offers a 14-level Instructor Assisted Freefall (IAF) training program for progressing skydivers. Reservations are required and weather may affect jump availability.
